title: 3D printed mucocompressive surgical stent with suture-anchor system for peri-implant keratinized mucosa augmentation: A proof-of-concept prospective single-cohort study
html: Poor peri-implant soft tissue conditions in the reconstructed jaw pose challenges to long-term implant success rates. Although several peri-implant soft tissue management techniques in reconstructed jaws have been described, studies evaluating their postoperative effectiveness are lacking.
